name: Artillery Cannon Belt (Connector)
description: Cannon ammo belts can store and transfer ammo shells. Connector belts allow ammo transfers between vehicles. Spawned ammo type can be set in component properties window.

logicNodes.label: Contains Ammo
logicNodes.description: Returns true if the belt contains a shell.

logicNodes.label: Connected
logicNodes.description: Returns true when two nearby receivers are aligned, and can transfer ammo between them.
